snippet.title: Heroes of Magic and Steel – Official Teaser Trailer | Tactical Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
Get ready to dive into a world where strategy, magic, and steel collide!

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist now:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226660/Heroes_of_Magic_and_Steel

🔥 Heroes of Magic and Steel is a tactical card game where you build your team, experiment with powerful combos, and face intense turn-based battles.

Create synergies, explore dark fantasy settings, and follow the development of a universe crafted by people who love games as much as you do.

🎮 Developed by Gaister Studios
Follow us on social media for updates and behind-the-scenes content!

#HeroesOfMagicAndSteel #IndieGame #TacticalRPG #DeckBuilder #IndieDev #SteamWishlist #GaisterStudios
